study_identification_part.si4_title: Gray matter atrophy is constrained by normal structural brain network architecture in depression

cm1_research_objectives.reason: Objectives are clearly stated: to investigate whether individual-level gray matter atrophy patterns in depression are constrained by normal connectome architecture, identify disease epicenters, test propagation via connectivity, and explore subgroups. This directly addresses research questions and the purpose of applying normative modeling for individualized analysis and disease understanding.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "we aimed to investigate the association between gray matter atrophy and normal connectome architecture at individual level in depression." ... "For each patient, individualized regional atrophy was assessed using normative model..." ... "we investigated whether the association ... could help to uncover homogeneous subgroups in depression."

nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.reason: Eligibility criteria for healthy controls are described (community recruitment; no serious medical/neuropsychiatric illness; no family history in first-degree relatives; Han Chinese; right-handed; additional exclusions: recent drugs, substance abuse, neurological history, systemic illness, MRI contraindications). Image quality standards are partly specified: motion thresholds for fMRI, IQR recorded for structural images. Final sample sizes are reported, but detailed counts/reasons for exclusions beyond motion are not provided.
nm1_selection_criteria_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "Healthy controls (HCs) were recruited from the community... None of them presented a history of serious medical or neuropsychiatric illness or a family history... Patients and HCs were all Han Chinese and right handedness. For all participants... additional exclusion criteria included: (1) taking drugs... (2) substance abuse; (3) a history of brain tumor... (5) contraindications for MRI..." ... "Subjects were excluded if the translational and rotational displacement exceeded 3.0 mm or 3.0°. None of the participants were removed for this criterion." ... "The Image Quality Rating (IQR) ... was recorded to assess images quality."

nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.reason: Age and sex are explicitly modeled as covariates in the Gaussian process regression trained on healthy controls to predict regional GMV. Multi-site harmonization is not needed because analyses are performed within each dataset/site separately.
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.supporting_text: "we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs and then applied the trained model to infer regional GMV of patients."
nm2_handling_of_covariates_reference_coh.location: Han2024A.pdf.md (Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern)

nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.reason: The study builds new normative models from two primary datasets. Data sources are specified with recruitment sites and ethics approvals for both discovery (First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University) and replication (Clinical Hospital of Chengdu Brain Science Institute, UESTC) datasets.
nm3_data_sources_reference_cohort.supporting_text: "The discovery dataset included 105 never-treated first-episode patients ... and matched 130 healthy controls (HCs) recruited from ... the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University... The replication dataset included 106 patients ... and matched 126 HCs... approved by the research ethical committee..."

nm5_data_preprocessing.reason: Preprocessing software and steps are described: VBM with CAT12 including segmentation, normalization, modulation, smoothing, and IQR recording; fMRI preprocessing with SPM12 and DPABI (volume removal, slice timing, realignment, normalization, smoothing, detrending, band-pass filtering, nuisance regression, despiking), motion thresholds, and FD calculation.
nm5_data_preprocessing.supporting_text: "GMV was measured with VBM ... using ... CAT12 ... segmented ... normalized ... smoothed ... IQR ... recorded to assess images quality." ... "Functional images were preprocessed using SPM12 ... and DPABI ... removing the first 10 volumes, slice timing and realignment ... normalized to the standard EPI template ... smoothed ... detrended ... Band-pass filtered ... Nuisance covariates ... were regressed out ... outliers ... detected ... mean frame-wise displacement (FD) was calculated."

nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.reason: No data partitioning (e.g., held-out test set or cross-validation) for the normative model on the healthy reference cohort is described. The Gaussian process model is trained on HCs and applied to patients without reporting internal validation on held-out HCs.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: No explicit mention of cross-validation, hold-out testing, or similar internal validation for the GPR normative model on HCs.
nm6_internal_data_validation_reference_c.location: Han2024A.pdf.md (Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern)

nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.reason: Although the study uses a separate replication dataset, the normative model for each dataset is built from that dataset’s HCs. There is no application of a reference cohort model to an independent external healthy dataset not used for model development.
nm7_external_data_validation_reference_c.supporting_text: "All results reported in the main text were based on the discovery dataset and reproduced on the replication dataset." (Replication uses its own dataset rather than applying a pre-trained HC model to external HCs.)

nm8_normative_modeling_approach.reason: The statistical model is specified as Gaussian process regression predicting regional GMV from age and sex, and Z-scores are computed using predictive uncertainty. However, key model settings (e.g., kernel type, hyperparameter priors) and software/library used for GPR are not specified.
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.supporting_text: "we trained a Gaussian process regression model to predict regional GMV from age and sex in HCs ... For each brain region, the Z-score was obtained ... normalized by the uncertainty of prediction."
nm8_normative_modeling_approach.location: Han2024A.pdf.md (Determination of individualized gray matter atrophy pattern)
